fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/ElectricCommercialVehicles.cy.js#Homepage - ElectricCommercialVehicles [en] TC-ECV-05: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-ECV-05
**Title:** Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Check Offers in Electric Commercial Vehicles and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Check Offers on one visible card
2. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
3. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
descriptionHtml:
Test Case ID: TC-ECV-05
Title: Check Offers lead form shows required validation when submitted empty
Language: en

Description:
Open Check Offers in Electric Commercial Vehicles and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

Expected Result:
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

Steps:

  1. Open Check Offers on one visible card
  2. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
  3. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
